hypothesis: Daily close-to-open IBS execution captures at least 2% per year more net alpha than Track 1 weekly IBS execution after realistic costs.
economic_context: Historical characterization found that IBS-related relative performance is concentrated in the overnight window while next-open-to-close long-only implementation is not viable. This is a prospective execution-frequency experiment, not a historical validation exercise.

signal.earnings_policy: ARQ filing-date earnings names are assigned neutral score 0.50 and excluded from overnight portfolio selection; non-earnings IBS only.
signal.source_equivalence: Uses the existing paper-trading IBS implementation and eligibility/exclusion formulas.

universe.common: Domestic common stocks, same price/history/sector filters as Tracks 1-3; exclude Financial Services, Real Estate, Healthcare; then apply NSI Q5 and Quality Q5 exclusions.
universe.full: Track 4A: all eligible names after exclusions.
universe.liquid: Track 4B: retain the top trailing-20-session median-dollar-volume quintile before applying the same exclusions.

execution.signal_time: regular-session close on trading day t
execution.virtual_entry: same regular-session close on t, using Sharadar close; this is a virtual close fill for prospective measurement
execution.virtual_exit: first Alpaca IEX one-minute bar open at or after 09:30 ET on the next trading session, retrieved after 10:00 ET
execution.holding_window: close[t] to open[t+1] only; no intraday hold
execution.timing_resolution_note: The phrase 'next-day open entry' in the request conflicts with a close-to-open holding period. This specification intentionally uses close entry and next-open exit to measure the stated overnight window.

portfolio.notional: same configured virtual notional as Tracks 1-3

cost_model.application: charged once per completed overnight portfolio, independent of realized gap

comparisons.primary: Track 1 IBS Standalone weekly virtual-fill return
comparisons.secondary: SPY adjusted-total-return performance over aligned dates

acceptance_criteria.daily_adds_value: net alpha versus Track 1 >= 2% per year and t-statistic > 1.5
acceptance_criteria.marginal: net alpha versus Track 1 is positive but <2% per year, or t-statistic <1.5; weekly remains preferred
acceptance_criteria.weekly_superior: net alpha versus Track 1 is negative; discard daily execution

observation.inception: next Friday after preregistration commit and dry-run approval
observation.historical_backtest: prohibited; original historical holdout is exhausted

launch_gate: Run --dry-run-daily and review its output. Do not register scheduled tasks or invoke --record-daily until explicit user approval.
